notices.title: Stratford (London) Rail Station
notices.detail: MILDMAY LINE: Wednesday 28 and Thursday 29 October, after 2300 each evening, no eastbound service from Willesden Junction to Stratford. Customers should use the last eastbound services detailed or London Overground services to Euston. Last through trains: Clapham Junction to Stratford 2218; Richmond to Stratford 2232; Willesden Junction to Stratford 2252. In addition, the 2249 train from Richmond to Stratford will not run, the 2302 train from Richmond to Stratford will terminate at Willesden Junction and the 2318 train from Richmond to Willesden Junction will not run
